Tread carefully whelp, you have much to overcome.
|Dog controls your destiny. Seek out three items of his favour and then seek his shrine.
Grrr!
Hey you! Yeah you! You gots meat? You gots brains? You low on creds, eh? Why not you wanna try fighting here for the money, eh?
Hey, that too bad. He need nuyen more than you anyway! Maybe you come back later.
You don't look so good. Crawl somewhere else if you goin' to check out. You need time to |heal.
I don't know. You need some rest maybe.
You not last long enough. Crowds not like unfair fight. Get some rest!
I don't believe it. You beat the King! Here's 3000 nuyen!
Things different now in caryards. No-one to protect the people!
Better you leave! Go now, no more talk!
You do enough damage for one day! King was best fighter. You leave before crowds join arena!
You some sort of warrior!?!
You must do this thing for a living, eh?! You better than I thought!
Huh? No more people are left to fight!
King was only playing that time. Lucky he let you live!
He much too good. Maybe you rest and try again.
I don't know. You need some rest maybe!
King like you even less now!
How's ya goin' kid? You look like you need refreshments!
Looks like it's your shout too! I'll have whatever you're having.
Do I look like an encyclopaedia?
|Hiring them isn't cheap... but if you need the extra muscle or the expertise, they're the ones you want.
Har har! Show me your wallet and I'll show you a man with twenty fingers.
What? You don't believe me, just try me!
Buzz, chummer! I can only stand talking to breeders for so long!
Don't need 'em, except for the doc round the corner who did some work on my face. You like it?
If you just want guns there's Vivyan's around the corner. If you're looking for something not quite legal, then you won't find 'em around here.
I'm not for hire! If you're looking for a |decker, look somewhere else!
My price is not even worth discussing, chummer.
Can't help you...
It's where all the information is. It's where the power is. Control the Matrix, and you control the world.
Unless you do it yourself, a good decker can get into the Matrix and grab the information you need.
You don't look too healthy.
You should maybe see a |street |doc. You look like you've been through a lot.
Can't help you there...
I never work alone. If you need someone to spring some doors open, try Wastelands. There's plenty of deckers there.
Ed's round the corner is OK I guess. He fixed my datajack when I had trouble jacking into the Matrix.
I've had a rough day. I need some rest.
Look, I just want to relax and unwind.
I'm too tired, maybe later...
Cheers chummer, my favourite too...
I almost had them, I had the |tickets in my hand! *SOB*SOB*
I'm too beat. What was that?
Tickets to the |Maria Mercurial concert. They were almost mine. I even gave |Grinder the money!
Maria Mercurial is the hottest thing in town! She doesn't come by these parts too often.
Poor Grinder. He got wasted by |Lone |Star. The morgue guys carried off what was left of him.
Haven't seen you for a while! Your usual I suppose...
One iced tea, comin' right up!
You look pale...
Someone after you? Maybe you should hire some |shadowrunners to watch your back!
Some of them carry some pretty lethal |firearms! They could really help you out.
If you haven't got one already, you'd best get armed.
So what's been happening with you? Last I heard, some Mr. Johnson had you lined up for a run.
I never quite picked you as a |shadowrunner.
Ain't heard... but I'll let you know if I do.
There's a few who are regulars. |Deckers mostly. Why you thinking of |hiring?
If you don't have a cyberdeck, I wouldn't go jacking in to the Matrix with only your |datajack. Best hire a decker to do the job for you!
Hiring them can be expensive. But if it keeps you alive...
Something wrong? Last time I saw you, you didn't have that datajack. Can't you remember even having it fitted?
Hi, what'll it be?
Working here at The Cage hasn't done my hearing any good. What was it you wanted?
You'll have to speak up.
Mr Glutman has run up quite a bill tonight. I think he's waiting for someone.
She's one talented lady. Just look at her move.

Very few of 'em frequent this joint. The Cage don't allow |firearms inside and the runners don't like leavin' em at the door in case trouble breaks out. The Orc at the door sometimes forgets to check though.
Duuuh, no entry without an official... |ticket!
Come back when you got a ticket.
Duh? What?
You're not getting in without 'em, bub!
Huh? Don't do anything stupid!
Don't bother me, and stay out of trouble!
You trying to be smart, drekhead?
What do you want? Can't you see I'm busy?
Take a hike, bowb. I've got nothing for you.
Go buy yourself a new Stim, Wirehead and get out of my life.
You drive a hard bargain...
Not sure about that. You know where to find me though if you've run out of uses for your hardware.
If you're |hiring, they have almost any skill you could want.
You're going to need plenty of money... at least 500 nuyen. If you're a fast talker you might |negotiate your way to something better.
That stuff moves fast. All I've got are some grenades from a munitions dump heist. 100 nuyen. You want one?
On the streets, a good negotiator can save themselves a lot of money.
Keep your voice down. Do you have something you want to offload? It had better be good, and the less heat behind it the better!
You don't seem to know what I mean! Are you a |shadowrunner?
No more questions! You'll have to leave. Now!
Jake, you is lucky man. You still alive!
If you're not going to hide boy, you'd best go after them that are after you!
V'at? Your head still broken?
Drake is after you man. No v'un ever see Drake for real. Or at least no v'un who lived.
Hey Mac. What ya want?
Cut the yappin'. Ya want something or not?
If ya ain't gonna buy something, beat it, joker.
Yeah Mac? What's the problem?
If ya just want to yap, talk to the customers. I've got work to do.
How would I know? Ask around and you might not get beat up.
What do you think the thing is at the end of the street, Mac?
There's a place around the corner - next to the wholesale weirdo shop.
King! Mac, you don't wanna shorten your life span.
Talismans? Hey guys, we got a weirdo on our hands!
Shadowrunners? Sure, there's people for hire. You want muscle, you wanna try the Orcs.
You won't get a better price than that!
Let's stick to the price of weapons...
Yar har har. Cost ya good nuyen or two little puppy dogs.
Come in! Come in! Don't let a small problem turn into a big one! Welcome to Ed's Patch 'n' Fix.
You look pretty beat-up. Anything you want me to take a look at?
Sorry, small lapse in concentration. What were you saying?
Sure. Sure. Just hop up on the table here. You do have 500 nuyen, right?
Well if you're having trouble getting in to the Matrix, that could be your problem. I can do a quick |examination for 500 nuyen.
Jake, the problem seems to be in your head computer. There's a |cortex |bomb attached to it!
It's um... designed to destroy anything stored in your head computer if it is tampered with!
Um, I think it started ticking... if it goes off, it's likely to take a good portion of your head along with it. Sorry, here's a refund... try some aspirin. I don't think I can help you.
The only guy I know who might be able to help you is Dr Maplethorpe. He's expensive though. You should save your money for a good funeral!
I don't think I should mess with it anymore. You'd best find yourself another street doc.
How are you feeling Jake? Is your head OK?
I hope you get someone to look at that cortex bomb of yours.
They're quite dangerous. Maybe you should stand back a little.
Dr Maplethorpe is the only guy I know who might be able to help.
Do you have any business being 'round these parts?
I'm just doing my job. Now out with it or I'm going to have to run a check on you!
If you've got no reason for being here then take off! You're lucky this time!
Well why didn't you say so! The doc's in through those doors.
Nice hardware. There aren't many of those around...
Huh? You got any other stuff you wanna get rid of?
Those lying creeps next door? We had a deal, they'd handle the cops, and I'd supply their hardware needs. Lone Star almost busted through here last week.
I outfit whoever can pay. A few of my clients can be found at Jagged Nails, but I suggest you forget who told you!
The biggest and the best. I'll even give you a good price on any hardware you don't see yourself needing anymore.
Excuse me sir. The Dark Blade is for members only.
I'm sorry, but I'm going to have to ask you to leave the premises.
Please leave or I will be forced to call security.
We have a very strict policy. Non-members are not allowed in without prior appointment.
Ahh, the amulet. Mr Vladimir is expecting you. He's in the reading room. First room on your left. Please go through.
Nice to meet you Jake. I hear you have a problem with your head.
Is that so? You couldn't be a bit more specific could you?
Irrelevant! Stick to the facts, Jake.
Yes, nasty... Get up on the table here and I will disarm it immediately.
You've come to the best. I'm sure I can help, Jake.
If you get into difficulty, maybe you should buy some of these slap patches. I sell them for 100 nuyen.
Jake, I've managed to remove the cortex bomb. It seems to have been fitted to protect your |head |computer. Whatever is stored in there must be very valuable!
The data in your head computer looks like some bio-storage graft. I couldn't access it with my equipment. The maker is |Matrix |Systems, a little outfit over by the bay.
Jake, I've got other work to do.
I know very little about them. Except their work mainly revolved around software for the Matrix.
I'm afraid I can't access it. You'll have to find someone who knows what's in there and how to get it out.
Well that was quick! I thought you'd be trying to track down that |Matrix |Systems place. What can I do for you?
You just can't beat the best Chiba has to offer. Quality costs, you know.
Hmmm... I don't see how that relates to our present situation, Jake.
Hoi chummer, always room for a true shadowrunner. You handled that Stilettos gang mighty fine.
It's a bit busier than usual tonight. You wanna come in? 50 nuyen.
I don't know. Anyway, I'd better get back to weeding out these pretenders.
Since that guy who went batty on the dance floor, the Jagged Nails has been exclusively for shadowrunners.
As long as you got the money, you won't be disappointed. If you need some magic, try Kitsune.
You don't look like a regular, bowb. The Jagged Nail is for shadowrunners only. Come back when you're a little less green.
Sorry, can't help you tonight. You'll need 50 nuyen and a good rep before you'll grace the insides of these walls. Now jet!
Look bowb, if you don't back off, I'm gonna bounce you right out of Seattle!
If you have to ask, then you obviously ain't one. Make sure you hire some real runners if ya ever go walking the shadows.
What you want? Just got meself some sleep an' you mess it up.
You ain't one of them pointy ears are you?
Beats me.
Darling - nice outfit! Very street level. Not like some weirdos we've had in here. Unusual aftershave!
Oooh, oodles of entertainment tonight. |Kitsune's performing until twelve, and I get off at one.
Is there anything special I can get you?
Hmmmph! Well catch her act if you've got the time. She just uses this place as a cover to pick up on any good runs on offer.
Oh, so you're one of that crowd. Well it's who you know that counts! You should mingle a little...and there's also Kitsune if you can get her off the stage.
Hmmm. Maybe I can help you, and maybe I can't. For only 100 nuyen, I'll put you in touch.
We get all types. We even had a vampire in here once. The |strobes sent him catatonic. Took us fifteen minutes to realise he wasn't doing some new dance craze.
We just got a new lighting rig. Makes the place look much nicer. The old ones are around here somewhere.
That sounds like something you're better off asking a magic user.
Welcome! How can I help you?
Mr Maplethorpe is quite a busy man. Is there anything specific you need?
Maybe you should come back later.
The doctor is a skilled surgeon. Perhaps you could come back when you have something more specific he can help you with. Ed's Patch'n'Fix over by the caryards might be able to help you.
I'll just go see if the doctor is free.
This is the office of Mr Maplethorpe MD. Can I help you?
Oh no! I'll get the doctor right away! He charges 2000 nuyen though.
Dog calls to you. Seek him soon or you will be lost.
Woof. Woof. Grrr.
Grrr. Woof. Woof.
I am H'oochin-ikwa, the spirit of the Dog. I smell the power burning in your soul.
Prove to me that you are truly a friend to the Dog, and I shall grant you my guidance. Destroy the |Rat shaman and then return. You will find the entrance to his lair where souls are at rest.
Go now! Do not return until you have vanquished your enemy.
You have done well. You have served H'oochin-ikwa. You have cleaned the world of an enemy. Dog takes you as his own. From this time on, you travel with H'oochin-ikwa at your side.
Jake, you are in truth a shaman. Follow your calling. You know it to be true. Technology has been thrust upon you. You are fated to use it to destroy your nemesis.
The serpent who walks like a man. You will not defeat him with your own power. Capture a mighty spirit and use this as your weapon against Drake.
That answer is hidden in the mists.
It is a place where technology rules. A foul place. They seek to usurp the ancient order and conquer magic through using machines. You are fated to destroy Aneki, or yourself be destroyed.
Children besotted by the evil path. They spill blood, but only the one who leads them drinks. He is a dark child - a vampire. Beware!
A powerful enemy! He toys with you. He is a spirit of technology in decay. Find such a place, and you will have found his lair. Recite his true name, and you will have bound him to your will.
A soul struck down. You carry the result of his labour. You are entrusted with the future.
I am H'oochin-ikwa, the spirit of the Dog. I will guide you to your destiny.
Jake! It's me Sassie. I've been waiting for you. Come closer...
I'm sorry we ever broke up, Jake. Come closer... don't leave me!
Come closer, Jake! I'll tell you if you come closer!
Hey, you! Stop right there! Aneki Security. Where's your pass?
No pass. No entry. No exceptions.
You have exactly 5 seconds to produce a pass before I remove you from this planet!
Don't touch! Unless you're buying of course...
I've got pieces you can't even get on the open market. There's some more stuff coming soon. I'm just waiting for the heat to die down.
We don't deal in information, bub! Strictly guns!
Darned music! Them shadowrunner types blasting away with that racket at all hours. It's no wonder guests don't stay long!
You looking for a room? There's only one left. First room on the left! 50 nuyen. You want it?
You look mighty tired! Sure you don't want to take a rest?
You got a reason for being in my face?
Hey I'm trying to watch the band - OK?
You wanna start pushing daisies, just keep on annoyin' me, joker.
Sure, I can get you ice. I only deal in it a ton at a time though. Cost you 100 nuyen. You interested?
Mermaid? I suppose you'd find them in the water!
Give me a place where you want it dumped.
Come on pal, I've got other deliveries to make. Where do you want it?
I don't think we're understanding each other! Got any other ideas?
You got it! I'll do it as soon as the band finishes this song.
No way! You'll be lucky to find anyone delivering out there. Forget it!
Oh, woe is me. The Rat shaman has been defeated. Jake, you are getting good at this! Do you think you are a match for the |Jester?
Do you like games, little man? How about one where you guess my name! If you return lacking that simple truth, I'm afraid there are no losers... I'll just vaporise you! Ha ha ha ha!!!
Run and hide, flesh bag. Time is on your side, but nothing is going to save you! Ha ha ha ha!!!
Not so fast! You leave me no time to toy with you...and nevertheless, you are wrong. Do not return as foolish as you are!
Well, ye be a lookin' for a ship? The |docks are the right place.
Longhorn Jack they call me. Finest taxi-boat driver in this fine city.
That be a little out of my area. Could ye keep it to Seattle?
Bremerton - sorry, that be not possible. |Mermaids in the waters 'round here attack anybody who heads in that direction.
They turned up a while back and have been here ever since. They seem to like the warm run-off from the sewers. Keeps the waters warm. Can't say I don't like it myself, but it's been bad for business.
Except for the spirits, they be mostly deserted now. People came shooting and taking people away a while back. Some rough types now guard the warehouses.
Ye be lookin for a boat?
Me boats ready for hire or me name ain't Longhorn Jack!
OK so me name is Shirley Temple. Ye wanna hire me boat or what?
Bremerton. That's a fair way. There be dragons and other nasties around there. You can hire me boat for 1,000 nuyen upfront. If ye don't like ye can leave it.
Let's stay calm. I'm sure we can deal! Ease off the trigger and I'll fly you where you wanna go...
Look, just decide where you want to go, and stop pointing that gun at me, will ya!
You need to tell me where you want me to fly this bird, chummer.
Hold on, chummer! That place don't take to visitors too kindly.
Where do you want me to land? On the water? Sorry, no can do.
I just keep my eyes open and my mouth shut. Less heat from the boss that way.
The Drake Volcano? It's YOUR funeral! Climb aboard and get that gun outta my face!
Hi, what can I get you?
I let Cecil do the socialising. I merely serve the customers, dear!
I don't know... how about some juice?
Well seeing that you talked to Cecil, I suppose you can have them. Careful where you shine them though, they're a bit hard on the eyes.
I can't see what you'd ever want with a bunch of |vampires.
When she's not running the shadows, she's running around howling on stage.
Aaarrggh. You swine!
Drek, you've bought into more trouble than you know. The |Rust |Stilettos always finish a job! Aaarrggh, bye sucker!
GASP... URGH...
You're dead, Armitage! You're dog-meat! |Drake's gonna fry you. Don't even try running. You can't hide from the Drake.
He's gonna rip you apart, Armitage!
I ain't telling you nothing!
Drake's not gonna let you live. You're history!
Back off, chummer. You're on Rust Stiletto turf.
Get off our zone, drekhead... or I'll wear your fingers as jewellery!
You hard of hearing? You'll be hard of breathing soon!
Well you found us! Now take off or I'll feed you to the boss!
Huh? What? Are you speaking to me?
Look I'm in a real hurry. Bye.
Will you please leave me alone!
Welcome to the Dark Blade. We don't often have guests, but when we do they tend to stay.
You come here on business? I'd be happy to have you for dinner!
Don't waste my time. I can be most unpleasant!
An amulet inscribed with a bat? You have my interest. What do you ask for such a prize.

So you seek to control the Jester Spirit! Even if I gave you his true name, you would never get close enough to utter it to his face. Give me the fetish first, then I shall give you the word that will be your downfall!
Finally! I have been waiting for this. It brings back memories of Transylvania...
This holds a spirit of true power... and you want to play with Jesters. Ha!
Do not annoy me. I wish to be left alone.

You are a fool, but nevertheless, I will tell you. To control the Jester's power, you must utter his true name in his presence. He can be found in the ship's bones at |Bremerton. The name you seek is... |Nirwanda!
Arrgghh! I can't see! Wait! A stake! Arrgghh! No!
I'll tell you anything! Anything! Just keep that stake away from me!
I've told you everything I know! I'm not lying - believe me!
His name is |Nirwanda. It's Nirwanda! You'll find him at |Bremerton. Please go away!
Leave me alone! I'm not hurting anyone!
Go away! I've told you everything that I know.
That's all I know, honest. Why would I lie?
It's Nirwanda... No, OK it's |Laughlyn! It's Laughlyn! You'll find him in |Bremerton. He haunts some ship down there. Now go away!
Yo man. What's been happenin'? You gone underground lately?
Say what? Man, what a bummer! Want an iced tea? I'll have to hold the |ice.
That's like, nothing I can help you with.
Sorry, no ice. The freezer's on the fritz. We're waiting on a delivery...
All kinds hang here! Mercs, mages, deckers... If you've got the money then, no problem!
You'd better be a good leader, or they'll take off and go where the money is better.

Man, I shouldn't be telling ya this, but I wouldn't wanna lose a good customer like you. There's a price on your head! Rust Stilettos gang are aiming to collect. Small gang, big plans. They got backing somewhere.
Those blood suckers!? They're holed up at some club they have on the outskirts of town. You sure you wanna mess with |vampires?
They're hiding out somewhere near here. You'd better watch your back.
Yo dude! What's been going down?
Things are like so cool! Especially now that the guy with the |ice delivered.
The chiller is the dude over there in the corner.
I'm your waitress for tonight. Is there anything I can get you?
I'd love to chat, but the boss would sack me.
Stick to what's on the menu!
You have defeated me the only way possible. My power is yours to command.
Choose wisely where you wish to summon my power, for only once it will be.
That I do not know.
Great jokers are they, but their games are deadly. A great surprise they have in store for all.
This is my home, Bremerton provides me with a portal to what you call the real world.
Traitors to the world of spirits. For this they will suffer... but not from me.
Your totem is your strength. Do not question his guidance.
Protector of the jokers. You will be in for a warm reception if you plan to challenge him, for a |volcano is his home. If this is where you intend to call on me then so be it!
Beware, for I have already warned you... you may call on me only once!
The lair of Drake. He watches all from there! If that where my power be needed, then it will be!
That is my true name. You have guessed well.
Ha ha ha ha! A little flesh-bag! How sad - it really does think it has the power.
Run, run, run as fast as you can! You can't catch me, I'm the razorblade man!
Boys and girls come out to play! On the busy motorway!
You guessed wrong, little man!
I am the Jester, and you are no match for me, little man!
I'm surprised to see you're still alive. A few more minutes and I was gonna take off!
I bet Drake wasn't happy to see you. You were crazy coming here!
Calm down, chummer! I can't understand you...
So, do you wanna pack it in and go back to Drake Towers?
Thank you! Thank you for freeing me. My name is Professor Pushkin.
I have been kept prisoner like a caged animal. Drake is after an ANTI-AI program professor Raitsov was meant to send me. The courier never arrived.
There is no time to waste! We must hurry!
Professor Raitsov developed a program that could split the AI in Aneki's computer and destroy it! A courier with the ANTI-AI stored in his |head |computer was meant to deliver it to me.
So you're the courier! You're head computer must still have the ANTI-AI stored in it. We must interface it directly into Aneki's AI and destroy it! I have the code to get you in to Aneki!
Drake is working for |Aneki. Aneki has developed an AI computer that can dominate the whole Matrix. If they succeed, they will control the world!
Why, hello... Are you off to the club?
Well I'm off to party. You look like you could do with some loosening up yourself!
Hey? Not sure...
All the in people go there... but you'll need tickets.
Yeah, she's playing |The |Cage tonight. Coming along?
Tickets? If you ain't already got 'em, you're out of luck. Twice babe!
You look troubled, young man. Is something wrong?
You'd best be prepared. I've had to |heal enough men who thought they were safe running the shadows.
Slow down boy, you're talking too quick for me.
Soldiers of fortune! They hire out their skills to whoever can afford it! The corporations use them to do their dirty work.
Forget all that talk of magic, you're better off leaving yourself in the hands of a skilled |street |doc.
Pity I'm retired, but there are some good ones around. Most can handle tech like that datajack of yours.
You're asking for trouble if you jack into the Matrix direct. Use a cyberdeck, boy.
If you're here to rubberneck over that scalper, you're too late.
The |Lone |Star took out some guy unloading tickets to the Mercurial concert. He's got a date with the morticians.
Can't hang around dude!
The corporate cops enforce the law, man. But the corps make their own law.
I was here first. I always sit here. You can't make me move!
Uhhh... you looking for someone, bowb?
I don't know nothing. I stay alive that way!
Hi! Wiz music, don't you think?
I look familiar? What kind of line is that! Creep!
I can't hear you, the music is too loud!
You stay away from my girl now, you hear!
Don't go messing with my girl!
Beat it!
Jake, you're alive! I heard you were dead!
I got myself a new boyfriend and everything. The last of your stuff was just thrown out. You're still getting |calls. Tell your buddies to stop calling us!
Bye Jake!
Some |Glutman guy keeps calling. His number is 934-782.
Go now, my men hide you. No charge. Glutman owe you favour, ya! I fix everything! We hide you real good, you betcha!
No time, no time. You is dead man, come quickly.
No need to thank me, boy! Now let's hurry!
You won't survive long without one.
You look like you need some help.
You've got to be prepared for anything. I'm upgrading to something that isn't slowed down by armour.
You sure you don't need some help?
Maybe you should try something bigger than a pistol.
Guns guns guns! Yar ho hee har har!
You want to buy this gun? Good buy! Only one owner. He's no longer around, if ya know what I mean! Yar ho tee hee har.
Huh? Come on lad let's set our hair on fire!
I haven't got all day. What do you want?
Nice shades! Do you always wear them indoors?
Hurry up, will ya? I can feel my arteries hardening!
The only way you're gonna get a ticket from me chummer, is if I attach it to your big toe!
Somebody gave him an early retirement. We'll ship what's left of him tomorrow.
No sightseers allowed! If ya ain't family or you're not a badge I'm afraid he stays with us!
Well that's one more file out of the way. You wouldn't believe the number of guys fragged today!
Hey Larry, where's the little urn to ship number 8 in?
I can't talk to you and move my pen at the same time. Ask the other guy.
What now? I've got to explain to our boss how one of our stiffs just got up and left!
The ghoul just walked out the door! Sam and I made it into the closet just in time!
You know, you look familiar.
Hurry up pal, I can feel my arteries hardening!
The only way you're gonna get a ticket from me pal, is if I attach it to your big toe!
You Lone Star boys sure did him over good. His file and belongings are in the cabinet. Do you want me to pull his file for you?
What do you want, punk? I'm in a hurry!
I've got business to attend to. You looking for some kind of donation?
I gave at the office.
